note: Boyd County PVA parcels are published only through the Schneider qPublic/Beacon viewer (App=BoydCountyKY), a proprietary viewer with no public ArcGIS REST parcel service. The KY state server (kygisserver.ky.gov WGS84WM_Services) has parcel services only for Webster County, and the KYTC County PVA Availability layer marks Boyd as 'Without Ownership'. ArcGIS Hub/Online searches found no Boyd parcel FeatureServer; commercial vendors (Regrid, Dynamo, Acres) are not official sources.
